partner_result_applied.result: For T=2ZW+V^2, the parabolic trace N(h) equals 2||p_T||_infinity; bounded transverse/conditional caps alone do not bound N(h).
partner_result_applied.application: Combined with the new pair-or-ridge compiler to prove N(h)<44.209 delta^(-5/6)/s in the null-pair branch and N(h)<25.702/(sigma s) in the diffuse-ridge branch for product-linear null frames.

new_results.statement: If s3(A)>=s and either an indefinite physical pair has (D^2 kappa)^(1/5)>=delta s or an original-coordinate cross block has s3>=sigma s with oriented row norms <=s3/sqrt(12), then the full form has the stated dimension-free density bound.
For zero physical diagonal, failure of a delta-scale physical pair and failure of the diffuse-ridge certificate at a cut with s3>=sigma s forces a row effective support >sigma^2/(12 delta^2).
For canonical product-linear null frames, the partner parabolic trace is dimension-free on either the transverse physical-pair or diffuse-ridge certificate branch.

unresolved_implication: Prove many-small-pair heavy-star aggregation before inversion, preserving original-coordinate product-linear provenance; also handle the quantitative cross-rank-at-most-two complement. The full conjecture and full continuity statement remain open.
next_step: In a null-frame cut whose heavy row has large effective support but every entry is small, use independent original-coordinate aggregation before the parabolic trace, rather than conditional density caps or reciprocal fixed minors.
regularity: Essential boundedness in the physical-pair branch; continuous C0 density in the ridge branch only.
